subject: general
question: The United States has labeled which country a 'currency manipulator' in December 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Vietnam**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Currency manipulator **is a **designation applied **by **United States government **authorities.
 
• The authorities as the **United States Department **of the **Treasury**.
 
• Its **aim **is to **countries **that **engage **in **unfair currency practices **so that gives them **a trade advantage**.
 
• **Such practices **may be **currency intervention **or **monetary policy**.
 
• In **this practice**, a **central bank buys **or **sells foreign currency **in exchange for **domestic currency**.
 
• **Their intention **of **influence **the **exchange rate **and **commercial policy**.
 
• **In December 2020**, the **Trump administration **designated **Switzerland **and **Vietnam **as **currency manipulator.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Policymakers **may have **different reasons **for **currency intervention**, such as **controlling inflation**, **maintaining international competitiveness**, or **financial stability**.
 
• **Singapore**, **Switzerland**, **Taiwan**, and **Thailand **have been **regular manipulators **in both recent **years **and during the earlier **period, 2003–13**. **Singapore **and **Switzerland **together accounted for more than half of **total currency manipulation in 2020.**
